findings.message: Deterministic persistence resilience runner implemented, validating autosave cadence at 30-second intervals, non-blocking behavior during active edit, event-log replay across restart, and safe snapshot reload.
Machine-readable output implemented via PERSISTENCE_RESILIENCE_REPORT_JSON, enabling automated CI processing and reporting of persistence test results.
CI runner script created and properly integrated into scripts/run-quality-gates.sh, ensuring persistence resilience validation is part of standard quality gate pipeline.
Validation confirms all checks pass: run-persistence-resilience.sh (exit 0) and run-quality-gates.sh (exit 0). Scenario fidelity verified for all persistence operations.
Scenario coverage includes: autosave cadence verification, active-edit non-blocking validation, restart/reload event-log replay testing, and safe snapshot reload confirmation.
Documentation updated: README.md references new persistence resilience suite, backlog.yaml updated to reflect TASK-058 implementation.
